import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Disjoint-set structure in the "quick find" representation: `label[x]` is
    the representative of the component currently containing `x`. -/
structure UF where
  label : Array Nat

/-- Identity partition on `n` elements: every node is its own representative. -/
def UF.mk' (n : Nat) : UF := ⟨Array.ofFn (n := n) (fun i => i.val)⟩

/-- Representative of `x`. -/
def UF.find (uf : UF) (x : Nat) : Nat := uf.label.getD x x

/-- Merge the components of `x` and `y`: every member of `x`'s class is
    relabelled to `y`'s representative. -/
def UF.union' (uf : UF) (x y : Nat) : UF :=
  ⟨uf.label.map (fun l => if l = uf.find x then uf.find y else l)⟩

/-- Every directed adjacency entry of the graph, as an `MSTEdge`. -/
def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap
    (fun u => (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun p => ⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩))

/-- Step 1 of Kruskal: all edges sorted by non-decreasing weight. -/
def sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (allEdges g).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))

/-- Step 2 of Kruskal: accept an edge iff it joins two distinct components. -/
def kruskalStep (st : UF × List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge) : UF × List MSTEdge :=
  if st.1.find e.u = st.1.find e.v then st
  else (st.1.union' e.u e.v, st.2 ++ [e])

/-- Kruskal's algorithm. -/
def kruskalRun (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  ((sortedEdges g).foldl kruskalStep (UF.mk' g.size, [])).2

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  kruskalRun graph
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- Every edge produced by `allEdges` really is a directed edge of `g`. -/
theorem has_edge_of_mem_allEdges {g : WeightedGraph} {e : MSTEdge}
    (he : e ∈ allEdges g) : g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w := by
  unfold allEdges at he
  rw [List.mem_flatMap] at he
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hmem⟩ := he
  rw [List.mem_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨List.mem_range.mp hu, p, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  simpa using hp

/-- Sorting does not invent edges. -/
theorem mem_allEdges_of_mem_sortedEdges {g : WeightedGraph} {e : MSTEdge}
    (he : e ∈ sortedEdges g) : e ∈ allEdges g :=
  (List.mergeSort_perm _ _).subset he

/-- The Kruskal fold only ever accumulates edges taken from its input list. -/
theorem mem_foldl_kruskalStep {l : List MSTEdge} :
    ∀ (st : UF × List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge),
      e ∈ (l.foldl kruskalStep st).2 → e ∈ st.2 ∨ e ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => intro st e he; exact Or.inl he
  | cons a l ih =>
      intro st e he
      rcases ih (kruskalStep st a) e he with h | h
      · unfold kruskalStep at h
        split at h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h | h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · simp at h; exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])

/-- `edges_contain` is symmetric: the solution edge list is read undirected. -/
theorem edges_contain_symm {edges : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat}
    (h : edges_contain edges u v) : edges_contain edges v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, h.symm⟩

/-- `IsChain`-based reformulation of `path_follows_edges`. Working with
    `List.IsChain` instead of the `getD`-indexed predicate makes the standard
    path constructions (singleton, reverse, append) available from Mathlib. -/
def Conn (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
    List.IsChain (edges_contain edges) p

/-- Bridge: a nonempty chain is a `path_follows_edges` path. -/
theorem path_follows_edges_of_chain {edges : List MSTEdge} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), p ≠ [] → List.IsChain (edges_contain edges) p →
      path_follows_edges edges p := by
  intro p hne hc
  refine ⟨List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne, ?_⟩
  clear hne
  induction p with
  | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
      | cons b t' =>
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
          intro i hi
          cases i with
          | zero => simpa using hc.1
          | succ j =>
              have := ih hc.2 j (by simpa using hi)
              simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using this

/-- Every vertex pair being `Conn`-related gives the specification's
    connectivity predicate. -/
theorem is_connected_with_edges_of_conn {g : WeightedGraph} {edges : List MSTEdge}
    (h : ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size → Conn edges u v) :
    is_connected_with_edges g edges := by
  intro u v hu hv
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h u v hu hv
  refine ⟨p, h1, h2, path_follows_edges_of_chain p ?_ h3⟩
  intro hp; rw [hp] at h1; simp at h1

/-- Converse bridge: a `path_follows_edges` path is a chain. -/
theorem chain_of_path_follows_edges {edges : List MSTEdge} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), path_follows_edges edges p →
      List.IsChain (edges_contain edges) p := by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨-, hp⟩ := hp
  induction p with
  | nil => exact List.isChain_nil
  | cons a t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => exact List.isChain_singleton a
      | cons b t' =>
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
          refine ⟨by simpa using hp 0 (by simp), ih ?_⟩
          intro i hi
          have := hp (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
          simpa [List.getD_cons_succ] using this

/-- The specification's connectivity predicate gives `Conn` for every pair. -/
theorem conn_of_is_connected_with_edges {g : WeightedGraph} {edges : List MSTEdge}
    (h : is_connected_with_edges g edges) :
    ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size → Conn edges u v := by
  intro u v hu hv
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h u v hu hv
  exact ⟨p, h1, h2, chain_of_path_follows_edges p h3⟩

theorem Conn.refl (edges : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : Conn edges u u :=
  ⟨[u], rfl, rfl, List.isChain_singleton u⟩

theorem Conn.symm {edges : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Conn edges u v) :
    Conn edges v u := by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p.reverse, by simpa using h2, by simpa using h1, ?_⟩
  rw [List.isChain_reverse]
  exact h3.imp (fun _ _ hab => edges_contain_symm hab)

theorem Conn.trans {edges : List MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat}
    (h₁ : Conn edges u v) (h₂ : Conn edges v w) : Conn edges u w := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2, hq3⟩ := h₂
  cases q with
  | nil => simp at hq1
  | cons a q' =>
      have ha : a = v := by simpa using hq1
      subst ha
      cases q' with
      | nil =>
          have hw : a = w := by simpa using hq2
          subst hw
          exact ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩
      | cons b q'' =>
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hq3
          cases p with
          | nil => simp at hp1
          | cons c t =>
              refine ⟨(c :: t) ++ (b :: q''), by simpa using hp1, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [List.getLast?_append_cons]; simpa using hq2
              refine List.IsChain.append hp3 hq3.2 ?_
              intro x hx y hy
              simp only [hp2, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq, List.head?_cons] at hx hy
              subst hx; subst hy
              exact hq3.1

/-- Monotonicity of the undirected incidence predicate. -/
theorem edges_contain_mono {edges edges' : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat}
    (hsub : ∀ x ∈ edges, x ∈ edges') (h : edges_contain edges u v) :
    edges_contain edges' u v := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨x, hsub x hx, h⟩

theorem Conn.mono {edges edges' : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat}
    (hsub : ∀ x ∈ edges, x ∈ edges') (h : Conn edges u v) : Conn edges' u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3.imp (fun _ _ hab => edges_contain_mono hsub hab)⟩

/-- A single accepted edge adds exactly one undirected incidence. -/
theorem edges_contain_append_single {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} :
    edges_contain (acc ++ [e]) a b ↔
      edges_contain acc a b ∨ (a = e.u ∧ b = e.v) ∨ (a = e.v ∧ b = e.u) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, h⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx, h⟩
    · have hx : x = e := by simpa using hx
      subst hx
      rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h2.symm, h1.symm⟩)
  · rintro (h | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact edges_contain_mono (fun x hx => List.mem_append_left _ hx) h
    · exact ⟨e, by simp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨e, by simp, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Connectivity in `acc ++ [e]`, expressed without the new edge: either the two
    vertices were already connected, or the path crosses the new edge, which
    means each endpoint is `acc`-connected to one endpoint of `e`. -/
def ConnExt (acc : List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Conn acc u v ∨
    (Conn acc u e.u ∧ Conn acc e.v v) ∨ (Conn acc u e.v ∧ Conn acc e.u v)

theorem ConnExt.refl (acc : List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge) (u : Nat) :
    ConnExt acc e u u := Or.inl (Conn.refl acc u)

theorem ConnExt.trans {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {u v w : Nat}
    (h1 : ConnExt acc e u v) (h2 : ConnExt acc e v w) : ConnExt acc e u w := by
  rcases h1 with h1 | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ <;>
    rcases h2 with h2 | ⟨hc, hd⟩ | ⟨hc, hd⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h1.trans h2)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1.trans hc, hd⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h1.trans hc, hd⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha, hb.trans h2⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (ha.trans (((hb.trans hc).symm).trans hd))
  · exact Or.inl (ha.trans hd)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha, hb.trans h2⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (ha.trans hd)
  · exact Or.inl (ha.trans (((hb.trans hc).symm).trans hd))

/-- One step of a path in `acc ++ [e]`. -/
theorem ConnExt.of_step {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {a b : Nat}
    (h : edges_contain (acc ++ [e]) a b) : ConnExt acc e a b := by
  rcases edges_contain_append_single.mp h with h | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨[a, b], rfl, rfl,
      List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨h, List.isChain_singleton b⟩⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨Conn.refl _ _, Conn.refl _ _⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨Conn.refl _ _, Conn.refl _ _⟩)

theorem ConnExt.of_chain {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat), p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v →
      List.IsChain (edges_contain (acc ++ [e])) p → ConnExt acc e u v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v h1 _ _; simp at h1
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro u v h1 h2 h3
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using h1
      subst hau
      cases t with
      | nil =>
          have hv : a = v := by simpa using h2
          subst hv
          exact ConnExt.refl _ _ _
      | cons b t' =>
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h3
          exact (ConnExt.of_step h3.1).trans (ih b v rfl (by simpa using h2) h3.2)

/-- Characterisation of connectivity after accepting one more edge. -/
theorem conn_append_single_iff {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} :
    Conn (acc ++ [e]) u v ↔ ConnExt acc e u v := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ConnExt.of_chain p u v h1 h2 h3
  · have hsub : ∀ x ∈ acc, x ∈ acc ++ [e] := fun x hx => List.mem_append_left _ hx
    have hnew : Conn (acc ++ [e]) e.u e.v :=
      ⟨[e.u, e.v], rfl, rfl, List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr
        ⟨edges_contain_append_single.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)),
          List.isChain_singleton _⟩⟩
    rintro (h | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩)
    · exact h.mono hsub
    · exact ((ha.mono hsub).trans hnew).trans (hb.mono hsub)
    · exact ((ha.mono hsub).trans hnew.symm).trans (hb.mono hsub)

/-! ### Union-find (quick find) correctness -/

theorem UF.size_mk' (n : Nat) : (UF.mk' n).label.size = n := by
  simp [UF.mk']

theorem UF.size_union' (uf : UF) (x y : Nat) :
    (uf.union' x y).label.size = uf.label.size := by
  simp [UF.union']

theorem UF.find_mk' {n x : Nat} (h : x < n) : (UF.mk' n).find x = x := by
  simp [UF.mk', UF.find, Array.getD, h]

theorem UF.find_union' (uf : UF) (a b x : Nat) (h : x < uf.label.size) :
    (uf.union' a b).find x =
      (if uf.find x = uf.find a then uf.find b else uf.find x) := by
  unfold UF.union' UF.find
  simp only [Array.size_map, Array.getD, dif_pos h]
  simp [Array.getElem_map]

/-- The joint invariant of the Kruskal fold: the disjoint-set state has the
    right size, and its classes are exactly the connected components of the
    accepted edge list. -/
def UFInv (n : Nat) (st : UF × List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  st.1.label.size = n ∧
    ∀ u v, u < n → v < n → (st.1.find u = st.1.find v ↔ Conn st.2 u v)

/-- L3: the disjoint-set classes track the components of the accepted edges
    exactly, and that property is preserved by one Kruskal step. -/
theorem UFInv.step {n : Nat} {st : UF × List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge}
    (hu : e.u < n) (hv : e.v < n) (h : UFInv n st) : UFInv n (kruskalStep st e) := by
  obtain ⟨hsize, hiff⟩ := h
  by_cases hne : st.1.find e.u = st.1.find e.v
  · have hstep : kruskalStep st e = st := by simp only [kruskalStep, if_pos hne]
    rw [hstep]
    exact ⟨hsize, hiff⟩
  · have hstep : kruskalStep st e = (st.1.union' e.u e.v, st.2 ++ [e]) := by
      simp only [kruskalStep, if_neg hne]
    rw [hstep]
    refine ⟨by rw [UF.size_union']; exact hsize, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu' hv'
    have hlu : u < st.1.label.size := hsize ▸ hu'
    have hlv : v < st.1.label.size := hsize ▸ hv'
    rw [UF.find_union' st.1 e.u e.v u hlu, UF.find_union' st.1 e.u e.v v hlv,
      conn_append_single_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hEq
      by_cases hA : st.1.find u = st.1.find e.u <;>
        by_cases hB : st.1.find v = st.1.find e.u
      · exact Or.inl ((hiff u v hu' hv').mp (hA.trans hB.symm))
      · rw [if_pos hA, if_neg hB] at hEq
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨(hiff u e.u hu' hu).mp hA, (hiff e.v v hv hv').mp hEq⟩)
      · rw [if_neg hA, if_pos hB] at hEq
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨(hiff u e.v hu' hv).mp hEq, (hiff e.u v hu hv').mp hB.symm⟩)
      · rw [if_neg hA, if_neg hB] at hEq
        exact Or.inl ((hiff u v hu' hv').mp hEq)
    · rintro (hC | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      · rw [(hiff u v hu' hv').mpr hC]
      · have hA : st.1.find u = st.1.find e.u := (hiff u e.u hu' hu).mpr h1
        have hB : st.1.find e.v = st.1.find v := (hiff e.v v hv hv').mpr h2
        rw [if_pos hA]
        by_cases hB' : st.1.find v = st.1.find e.u
        · rw [if_pos hB']
        · rw [if_neg hB']
          exact hB
      · have hA : st.1.find u = st.1.find e.v := (hiff u e.v hu' hv).mpr h1
        have hB : st.1.find v = st.1.find e.u :=
          ((hiff e.u v hu hv').mpr h2).symm
        rw [if_pos hB]
        by_cases hA' : st.1.find u = st.1.find e.u
        · rw [if_pos hA']
        · rw [if_neg hA']
          exact hA

/-- The initial state satisfies the invariant. -/
theorem UFInv.init (n : Nat) : UFInv n (UF.mk' n, []) := by
  refine ⟨UF.size_mk' n, ?_⟩
  intro u v hu hv
  rw [UF.find_mk' hu, UF.find_mk' hv]
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; exact Conn.refl _ _
  · rintro ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩
    -- with no edges, every chain stays at its first vertex
    induction p generalizing u with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons a t ih =>
        have hau : a = u := by simpa using h1
        subst hau
        cases t with
        | nil => simpa using h2
        | cons b t' =>
            rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h3
            obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := h3.1
            simp at hx

/-- Validity: every returned edge is an edge of the graph. -/
theorem kruskalRun_valid (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ e ∈ kruskalRun g, e.is_valid g := by
  intro e he
  have := mem_foldl_kruskalStep (l := sortedEdges g) (UF.mk' g.size, []) e he
  rcases this with h | h
  · simp at h
  · exact has_edge_of_mem_allEdges (mem_allEdges_of_mem_sortedEdges h)
